caption:
In the volcanic highlands of Costa Rica, mountain roads tend to follow the highest ridgelines rather than cut across them. This means mountain biking in Costa Rica often presents gradients that defy gears, where the smartest pace is a steady walk. When the slope touches thirty percent, transitioning from riding to pushing your bike is not a defeat—it is simply how you respect the terrain. Up on these grassy ridges, the air is thin and cool, the forest is quiet, and the only schedule is the one you left at the coast. Which climbs make you glad to walk?
